title: What is changing in the Sahel?
summary: Test every variable over the West Sahel at once, and correct for testing so many, to see what has really changed since 1990.

steps.message: Scanning 12 variables over West Sahel, 1990-2025, for trends... Not in this quick scan (their data downloads take minutes): SMAP Soil Moisture (satellite retrieval). Investigate them directly.
Maximum Temperature at 2 Meters: +0.0143 degC per decade (p = 0.869).
Relative Humidity at 2 Meters: +1.51 % per decade (p = 0.00309).
All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance: -0.132 kW-hr/m^2/day per decade (p = 0.00285).
Scan complete: 12 variables tested over West Sahel; 5 show a significant trend after correcting for testing 12 variables at once.

scan_results.name: Liquid Water Equivalent Thickness (groundwater / ice mass anomaly)
scan_results.definition: How much extra or missing water is stored in a region (groundwater, soil, snow, lakes and ice together), measured as a depth of water, from tiny changes in Earth's gravity.

scan_results.name: Wind Speed at 2 Meters
scan_results.definition: The average wind speed two metres above the ground.

scan_results.name: Precipitation Corrected
scan_results.definition: How much rain and snow falls, as the depth of water it would make each day, corrected with rain-gauge data.

scan_results.name: Relative Humidity at 2 Meters
scan_results.definition: How close the air is to being saturated with water vapour, as a percentage.

scan_results.name: All Sky Surface Shortwave Downward Irradiance
scan_results.definition: How much sunlight energy reaches the ground each day, including the effect of clouds and haze.

scan_results.name: Profile Soil Wetness
scan_results.definition: How wet the whole soil column is, from the surface down to bedrock, from 0 (dry) to 1 (saturated).

scan_results.name: Root Zone Soil Wetness
scan_results.definition: How wet the soil is down where plant roots reach, from 0 (completely dry) to 1 (saturated).

scan_results.name: Surface Soil Wetness
scan_results.definition: How wet the top few centimetres of soil are, from 0 (completely dry) to 1 (saturated).

scan_results.name: Minimum Temperature at 2 Meters
scan_results.definition: The coldest air temperature of each day, usually just before dawn.

scan_results.name: Temperature at 2 Meters
scan_results.definition: The temperature of the air about two metres above the ground, the height of a weather station thermometer.

scan_results.name: Earth Skin Temperature
scan_results.definition: The temperature of the ground or water surface itself (the "skin"), not the air above it.

scan_results.name: Maximum Temperature at 2 Meters
scan_results.definition: The hottest air temperature of each day, two metres above the ground.
